title: Generic groundwater application orchestration — application-plan materialization
goal: Materialize one immutable generic per-window application plan from admitted F-GC48 topology, tile predictor responses and cell areas, reusing F-GC40/F-GC33/F-GC34 without solver or transaction ownership.
implemented: tile predictor inputs keyed by topology tile id
explicit cell-area inputs keyed by groundwater cell id
predictor SWAP/coupling/service/groundwater-lineage validation against F-GC48 topology
single groundwater-service validation for one prepared-solve plan
compensated area-weighted predictor reference head per cell
delegation to admitted F-GC40 cell response
delegation to admitted F-GC33 linear term
reuse of admitted F-GC48/F-GC34 API bindings
canonical contiguous tile ranges per cell

independent_qualification.claim: Plan outputs equal direct F-GC40/F-GC33 composition and publish through F-GC34 with identical slot/node/term values.

admission_criteria: exact-head F-GC49A owner O0/O2 qualification green
exact-head F-VQ121 independent O0/O2 qualification green
canonical delta reconciled with no dependency conflict
production delta limited to application-plan materializer
next_permitted_action: Open draft PR, obtain exact-head owner and F-VQ121 evidence, repair only scoped failures, then admit/close stage A. Only after stage A closes may F-GC49B production participant bridge implementation begin.
